title: What's new in v2.5.3
summary: Uptime on the ISP Health score card, and outages scored against the window you are looking at.

steps.title: Uptime
steps.listLabel: Outages scored against the window, not in flat minutes
steps.body: **Uptime** now sits above the three gauges, and outages are scored against the window you are looking at rather than in flat minutes. Fifteen minutes down is a very different line over a month than over a day, and those no longer cost the same. A long outage still lands hard wherever you look from, and a line that drops over and over is now judged on how often it does it.
